_note: Real firm data that is NEVER tracked (ruling 2026-11-10). Every path here is gitignored and local-only. A committed synthetic stand-in lives at fixtures/synthetic/<same path>; scripts/ensure-local-data.ts copies it into place only when the runtime file is absent. Read by scripts/ensure-local-data.ts, scripts/fixtures/build-synthetic-data.ts, scripts/prepush-confidential-scan.mjs and scripts/governance-check.ts. 'files' are exact repo-relative paths; 'dirs' match every file beneath them. 'optional' files may be absent on a checkout that holds real data (they are seeded only on an all-synthetic checkout and are never deploy inputs): the value locks, ratified with `npm run golden:ratify`, and local operator tables.
